headline: Knowledge Realty Trust reports record Q2 distribution with revenue up 13%
hook: Record payout from Mumbai-headquartered office REIT
summary: Knowledge Realty Trust declared a record quarterly distribution of ₹764 crore, marking an 11 per cent increase compared to the same period last year. Revenue for the Mumbai-headquartered office REIT jumped 13 per cent during the quarter. This performance reflects steady cash flows from commercial real estate assets. Indian retail investors holding REIT units benefit from these regular income distributions.
why_it_matters: Higher rental distributions boost cash yields for REIT investors
